goal: Wave 1 build: Compliance read API in audit-core

slices.title: Compliance read API in audit-core
slices.summary: Adds the owner and admin compliance read API in audit-core: paged events by chain_seq with an opaque keyset cursor, a signed manifest, POST verify, keys, and export-status (empty until S8). Needs the new audit:compliance:read:self scope (verevon-gateway only) and requireComplianceRole (owner or admin); each read writes a self-audit row.
test_commands: cd "apps/Control Plane/audit-core" && TEST_DATABASE_URL="postgres://postgres:t@localhost:55432/postgres?sslmode=disable" go vet ./... && go test ./...
